title: Performance Testing — practice
prompt: You are working on “Performance Testing” in a dedicated MongoDB practice environment. Which next step best demonstrates the skill while keeping the result reviewable?
objective: Apply performance testing and verify its result safely.

options: Create repeatable tests for normal, boundary and failure paths; make environment configuration explicit and keep integration/performance tests isolated from production.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.

expected_output: Create repeatable tests for normal, boundary and failure paths; make environment configuration explicit and keep integration/performance tests isolated from production.
acceptance_criteria: Choose an approach that directly addresses the stated MongoDB topic.
State the expected outcome and one verification step.
Respect the disposable-lab, security and version/deployment assumptions.
hints: Identify the data or operational behavior the task needs to demonstrate.
Use a small reproducible example and write down the expected result before running it.
Review an official reference and test one boundary or failure case.

grading_config.correct_answer: Create repeatable tests for normal, boundary and failure paths; make environment configuration explicit and keep integration/performance tests isolated from production.

retry_policy.feedback: Review the related lesson, compare your choice with the verification hints, and retry. Incorrect attempts do not award XP.

status_note: Draft exercise. Grading answer is kept in the repository-only solution file and must not be exposed from learner-facing APIs.
